text:
Sasha: Quick heads-up — starting change-window probe for r2026 (rollout id: roll-2026-56). Ramp plan: 5% -> 25% over 10m. If p95 latency or 5xx exceeds SLO, pause and rollback. Follow runbook and signal in this thread.

deploy-bot: deploy started roll-2026-56 • image=redwood/infer:r2026 • region=eu-west • service=embed-service • traffic=5%

Marie: Watching SLO dashboard (embed-service). Link: https://console/redwood/d/xyz/embed-service-slo :eyes:

TJ: I'll tail traces for any tail-latency. Ping me if an alert fires.

deploy-bot: rolling traffic -> 25% (scheduled) after 5m

Leo: Observing 5xx in eu-west-1 on embed-service: baseline 0.65% -> 1.4% in 2m. Digging into pod logs. :thinking_face:

Marie: Correlating now — looks aligned with KV-cache GC events on that GPU pool. p95 jumped 170ms -> 420ms.

Sasha: Pausing rollout — manual pause applied to roll-2026-56. Preparing rollback plan. Candidate previous stable: image=redwood/infer:r2026-ctrl. Need routing pin in eu-west.

Carla: I'll pin routing to r2026-ctrl in eu-west. Command I will run: 
```
# pin route to previous stable in eu-west
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood/v1/routes/pin" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \\n  -d '{"service":"embed-service","region":"eu-west","version":"r2026-ctrl"}'
```

Carla: Executing now...

ops-bot: route pin request accepted — ticket=RT-4821 (created by Carla)

deploy-bot: rollback started: roll-2026-56 -> target=r2026-ctrl • traffic: shifting 25% -> 100% over 3m

TJ: Quick note — enabling higher SLI sampling for the next 10m to capture noisy traces: sampling.rate=0.5

Marie: p95 trending down: 420ms -> 180ms after routing pin. 5xx back to 0.3% within 2m.

Sasha: Nice. Filing brief incident note and adding to release notes: "eu-west probe paused; rolled back to r2026-ctrl due to KV-cache GC induced latency spike."

Leo: Follow-up action for release runbook: add preflight check for KV-cache GC scheduling and a knob to disable GC during ramp. I'll open a PR against infra/playbooks.

Sasha: Thanks everyone. We'll block next window until GC tuning and do a smaller canary after fixes. :thumbsup:

Carla: PR for routing pin audit created (link in RT-4821).

ops-bot: incident RT-4821 updated with postmortem stub.

Sasha: Closing thread for now; will reopen if anything regresses.
